meta.title: Analogue corpus: published RU IT case prices and a pending TMK/EIS contract-registry merge
meta.purpose: Reference-class rows for the should-cost cockpit. Price is not effort; every row must be normalized with its scope vector.
meta.currency_policy: Rows keep the currency in which the source published the price. RUB and USD are NOT converted. Rows with currency USD carry normalization.fx_conversion_applied=false. Apply a sourced central-bank rate and record the rate and date at the point of use.
meta.basis: Published contract price, grant, total investment, list price, service price or project estimate. The basis is stated per row and must not be pooled across bases.

provenance.licence_note: Published case prices are cited with their URL and date. They are not a market survey and are not redistributed as a database.

confidence_legend.High: The source states the price and enough scope to identify what was bought.
confidence_legend.Medium: Reputable secondary source, blog market overview, or a range whose midpoint is arithmetic.
confidence_legend.Low: Small sample, stale figure, or ambiguous basis.
confidence_legend.Proxy: No defensible public price; the row is a planning estimate or a linguistic range converted into numbers.

merge_policy.dedupe: Keep the first row by merge key; never overwrite a published_case row with a registry row. Add a new row and set provenance_file to the registry file.
merge_policy.on_merge: Set corpus_source='tmk_eis', provenance_file='/home/koluchiy/Documents/RadioHack4.0/data/tmk_it_contracts.json', and re-run the scope normalization. Do not pool registry rows with published case rows without a scope vector.

row_schema.project_type: erp_1c | sap_migration | mes | cv_qc | predictive_maintenance | dwh_bi | kii_security | it_portfolio
row_schema.title: human-readable case name
row_schema.price_low/mid/high: numbers in the published currency; null when not disclosed
row_schema.price_basis: contract_price | grant_amount | total_investment | total_project_amount | total_project_cost | list_price | service_price | fixed_offer | project_estimate | project_budget | rnd_budget | survey_case_estimate | expert_estimate | it_portfolio | not_disclosed
row_schema.normalized_rub_per_hour_low/high: derived only when both price and effort are published
row_schema.scope_vector: users, integrations, sites, reports, data_volume, duration_months, includes_hardware, includes_licenses, includes_support, objects, work_centers, cameras
